property_summary: After any successful transferFrom to a nonzero recipient, the token id must exist as owned state (c.tokenURI(id) must not revert, since _ownerOf[id] becomes nonzero); the mutant writes `from` back into _ownerOf, so a token transferred away from the zero address never comes into existence and every tokenURI query for it reverts.
change_summary: Assign `from` instead of `to` to `_ownerOf[id]`, keeping ownership with the sender.
